caseName: Texas & Pacific Ry. Co. v. Texas
caseNameFull: Texas & Pacific Ry. Co. v. Texas
attorneys: Mr. T. D. Gresham, with whom Messrs. M. E. Clinton and Herbert Fitzpatrick were on the brief, for appellant., Mr. H. Grady Chandler, Assistant Attorney General of Texas, and Mr. William McCraw, Attorney General, with whom Mr. Scott Gaines, Assistant Attorney General, was on the brief, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal herein is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question. Zucht v. King, 260 U. S. 174, 176; Sugarman v. United States, 249 U. S. 182, 184; Roe v. Kansas, 278 U. S. 191.
